app.name: runwise
app.caption: Personal running workspace

app.mottoCopy: Every record is a clue for the next start.
app.serverSaved: Data is saved by the server

stats.headline: See your training rhythm.
stats.lede: Use distance, frequency, and time to find your next step.
stats.fromApi: Each segment is returned by the API
stats.noBuckets: There is no segment data for this period
stats.completeRun: Complete a run and a trend will appear here.

runs.headline: Every start is worth remembering.
runs.lede: Record real runs and slowly learn your rhythm.
runs.selectRunCopy: See training details and rule analysis.
runs.noStreams: No stream data is available for this run.
runs.streamUnavailable: Charts are unavailable until stream data is present.
runs.shoeLocked: The selected shoe is locked for this manual run.
runs.durationHint: Saved as seconds; decimals are supported.
runs.notesPlaceholder: Road conditions, body signals, or one sentence to keep…
runs.name: Name
runs.emptyCopy: Record a run or load sample data to explore Runwise.
runs.sampleNote: Sample data is written to the local development database through the API.
runs.nextRunAppears: Your next run will appear here.
runs.realEmpty: Connect Google Health in Settings or add a real run.

coach.headline: Train from the record you actually have.
coach.lede: Coach keeps the next step grounded in imported runs and provider health data.
coach.noRunContextCopy: Record or import a run before using this view.
coach.planUnavailable: There is no active training plan connected to this workspace.
coach.planUnavailableCopy: Runwise will keep this area blank until plan data exists. No readiness score or session recommendation is inferred here.
coach.noHealthCopy: Connect a provider or sync health data in Settings to add real context.

shoes.headline: Let your gear become part of training.
shoes.lede: Track every shoe's distance and know when it is time for a fresh pair.
shoes.emptyCopy: Add a pair and Runwise will accumulate the distance attached to its runs.
shoes.initialDistanceHint: Distance covered before adding this shoe.
shoes.imageUrlHint: Optional. A catalog image can also be selected.
shoes.catalog: Search by brand and model, or type your own. Color does not guarantee a matching photo.
shoes.priorityHint: Higher priority wins when rules overlap.
shoes.inferenceCopy: Preview rule-based assignments for runs without a locked shoe.
shoes.noPredictions: No eligible runs match the current rules.

settings.headline: Keep your data where you can see it.
settings.lede: Manage connections, bring in old records, and take your data with you anytime.
settings.sourcesCopy: Every source status comes from the Runwise API.
settings.googleHealthCopy: Connect Google Health when credentials are configured.
settings.connectCopy: Authorization opens in a new step. Runwise does not store provider secrets.
settings.inspectionCopy: This is the source JSON returned by the provider sync.
settings.notAvailable: No inspection data is available yet.
settings.portabilityCopy: Bring in history with CSV or download a complete JSON backup.
settings.importCopy: Runwise fields are supported; the result shows imported and skipped rows.
settings.exportCopy: Back up runs and shoes for migration.
settings.localRecordsCopy: Manual records are saved through the local development API.
settings.authRequired: Sign-in is required for this workspace.
settings.authOptional: Local development mode does not require sign-in.
settings.languageCopy: Choose the language for the entire interface.
settings.googleReady: Google Health is ready. Connect to authorize access to your data.

share.title: Create a public snapshot
share.copy: The snapshot includes summary metrics and excludes GPS and private notes.
share.publicCopy: This public snapshot contains summary data only.
share.notFound: This share link is unavailable or expired.
share.copyFailed: Copy was unavailable. Select the link to copy it manually.

auth.headline: Keep your running workspace in sync.
auth.copy: Sign in to access your private runs and shoes.
auth.resetSent: If the address is registered, a reset email is on its way.
auth.resetCopy: Enter your email and we will send a password reset link.
auth.accountCreated: Account created. Check your email if confirmation is required.
auth.configMissing: Cloud sign-in is required but Supabase is not configured.
